title: Manager at Technology Services Provider Expects Samsara Business to Grow 32% in 2026 but Sees a Need for Faster AI Improvements
expert: Manager at a value-added reseller/systems integrator serving U.S. retail and delivery fleets of 50–500 trucks
verdict: The reseller's Samsara business grew 5% y/y in Aug–Oct (vs a 4% target) as customers raised devices per truck to 3–3.5 from 2–2.5.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🟢 Devices per truck 3–3.5 vs 2–2.5, typical order 20 sets vs 15–17, first read on device density; supports multi-product attach. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↑
🟡 Business +5% y/y Aug–Oct, vs 2026-11-05 call's +20%–22%: much slower (small-fleet VAR); FY26 +32% outlook (estimate) is not reconciled.
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🟢 Prices +2%–3% per quarter (estimate), on Asian component and shipping costs; faster than 2026-11-05 call's +5%–7% y/y on platform deals; cost pass-through matches mgmt's component-cost GM cut (SB #62580). → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) →
Competition & share: 🔴 Loses deals when discount flexibility is limited, and Samsara must improve AI safety quickly vs Geotab and Motive; vs 2026-11-05 call (#1/#2 in RFPs): conflicting. → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↓

changes: Growth: +5% y/y vs 2026-11-05 call's +20%–22%: slower (small-fleet reseller).

thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): ↑ — devices per truck 3–3.5 vs 2–2.5; orders 20 sets vs 15–17.
Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost): → — +2%–3% per quarter price is cost pass-through and limits discounts.
Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↓ — AI safety needs faster improvement vs Motive and Geotab.
